articles.title: Lebanon summoned to a U.S. military headquarters: disarm Hezbollah or the occupation drags on, as U.N. peacekeepers head for the exit
articles.description: When a country is invited to negotiate its future at a foreign military headquarters, the venue tells you exactly who holds the pen and the power. This week, Lebanese and Israeli military delegations convened at U.S. Central Command headquarters in Tampa, Florida, for three days of Washington-brokered talks.
